isolation: Each scenario drove its own independent OAuth2/PKCE sign-in against Thunder SSO (a fresh browser session per caller: one for Sam, a separate one for Jordan, both against the test-caller login published on the roles-gate ticket) and called the deployed GET /greeting endpoint directly. The endpoint is stateless and read-only (no container to own), so isolation came from using fresh, independent sign-ins per scenario rather than from a resettable resource; no shared state was mutated or depended upon between scenarios.

scenarios.rule: Only a signed-in caller may request the greeting
scenarios.scenario: A signed-in caller receives the greeting
